title: HLSF 学生体验问卷 V3.0
instructions:
下面的问题用于了解你在两轮文创设计中的真实体验。两轮使用的文物和 AI 互动方式可能不同，请分别根据每轮的实际体验回答。

没有正确或错误答案，请根据自己的感受作答。
instructions_en:
The following questions ask about your actual experience in the two rounds of cultural-product design. The artifacts and AI interaction approaches may have differed between rounds. Please answer each section based on your actual experience in that round.

There are no right or wrong answers. Please answer according to how you felt.

questions.heading: 探索不同构思
questions.prompt: 使用第一轮 AI 工具时，我能够轻松探索不同的设计想法、选择或可能结果。
questions.prompt_en: When using the AI tool in the first round, I could easily explore different design ideas, options, or possible outcomes.

questions.heading: 追踪不同构思
questions.prompt: 第一轮 AI 工具帮助我梳理和追踪不同的设计想法、结果或可能性。
questions.prompt_en: The AI tool in the first round helped me organize and keep track of different design ideas, outcomes, or possibilities.

questions.heading: 艺术性表达
questions.prompt: 使用第一轮 AI 工具时，我觉得自己能够进行具有艺术性的表达。
questions.prompt_en: When using the AI tool in the first round, I felt able to express myself artistically.

questions.heading: 发挥创造力
questions.prompt: 使用第一轮 AI 工具创作时，我能够充分发挥自己的创造力。
questions.prompt_en: When creating with the AI tool in the first round, I could fully use my creativity.

questions.heading: 自主选择方向
questions.prompt: 在第一轮创作中，我觉得自己能够选择设计的方向。
questions.prompt_en: During the first round, I felt that I could choose the direction of my design.

questions.heading: 按照个人意愿创作
questions.prompt: 第一轮创作过程中，我觉得自己能够按照想要的方式开展设计。
questions.prompt_en: During the first round, I felt that I could carry out the design in the way I wanted.

questions.heading: 缺少自主决定
questions.prompt: 第一轮创作中，我感觉设计方向并不是由自己决定的。
questions.prompt_en: During the first round, I felt that the direction of the design was not decided by me.

questions.heading: 选择余地有限
questions.prompt: 第一轮创作中，我觉得自己几乎没有选择设计方向的余地。
questions.prompt_en: During the first round, I felt that I had almost no choice about the direction of my design.

questions.heading: Mental Effort
questions.prompt: 完成第一轮文创设计任务时，你投入了多少心理努力？
questions.prompt_en: How much mental effort did you invest in completing the cultural-product design task in the first round?
